# GEO citation scorecard (template)

**Cadence:** monthly. Copy this file to `docs/archive/snapshots/geo-citations-YYYY-MM.md` and fill results.

**Goal:** Measure whether AI engines cite `promptanatomy.app` (or spokes / Medium) for brand and category prompts — not Google ranking.

**Engines:** ChatGPT (search/browse), Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode / AI Overviews.

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| Cited | Y / N / Partial (brand mentioned, no URL) |
| URL cited | Exact URL if any |
| Sentiment | Positive / Neutral / Negative / N/A |
| Notes | Wrong entity, competitor cited, etc. |
